description: Look up makes, models, vehicle types, and manufacturer details in NHTSA's VPIC catalog, or list the model names NHTSA's datasets file a make and model year under. VPIC names often differ from the names complaints and NCAP ratings use (Silverado vs SILVERADO 1500), and a vehicle's recalls can be split between a series name and a base name. When a recall, complaint, or rating search comes back empty or partial, call operation="dataset_models" with make and modelYear, then search under each name it lists. No list enumerates recall names, so search recalls under both the series name and the base name.

limit.description: Results per page. Defaults to 100; at most 200 per page.

make.description: Make name (required for "models", "vehicle_types", and "dataset_models"). VPIC matches partial names in "models" and "vehicle_types"; "dataset_models" takes the full make name (e.g., "Chevrolet").

manufacturer.description: Manufacturer name or ID (for "manufacturer" operation). Partial match supported.

modelYear.description: Model year, a whole number. Filters "models" to that year; required for "dataset_models". Not accepted by other operations.

offset.description: Pagination offset into the full result list. Defaults to 0.

operation.description: "makes" (all VPIC makes), "models" (VPIC models for a make), "vehicle_types" (types for a make), "manufacturer" (manufacturer details), "dataset_models" (the model names NHTSA's complaint, NCAP, and VPIC lists carry for a make and model year; requires make and modelYear).

name: nhtsa_lookup_vehicles

cap.description: Maximum manufacturer records a single lookup retrieves.

datasetModels.description: Results for "dataset_models" operation, sorted by name

items.description: A model name merged across the lists

listedBy.description: Lists carrying this name: "products" (the names complaint searches match), "ncap" (the names NCAP rating searches match), "vpic" (VPIC base names, which some recall campaigns are filed under)

effectiveQuery.description: The operation with key args, e.g. "models make=Toyota year=2020".

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `inactive_argument`: An argument is not used by the chosen operation. `missing_operation_arg`: A required argument for the chosen operation was not provided. `limit_too_large`: limit exceeds the 200-row page maximum on a server set to reject an over-maximum limit rather than lower it. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

limit.description: Pagination limit used for this response

items.description: A single vehicle-type entry produced by this manufacturer

notice.description: Guidance when the result set is empty, the page is out of bounds, or limit was lowered to the page maximum.

offset.description: Pagination offset used for this response

returned.description: Number of results in the returned slice

shown.description: Manufacturer records retrieved before pagination, when the cap was reached.

totalCount.description: Results retrieved before pagination. For "manufacturer" this is capped — check the truncated field, since VPIC reports no match total.

truncated.description: True when the "manufacturer" lookup stopped at its retrieval cap and further matches may exist upstream.

title: Nhtsa Lookup Vehicles
